summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for embeddings + semantic search POC; exploring Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Interested in vector DB integration and nightly batch embedding jobs. Cost-sensitive but operational/latency guarantees matter for SLAs to enterprise customers.
notes: Background: Searchlytics provides product analytics with ~400 customers; expanding advanced search & recommendations features.
Initial ask: replace in-house embedding pipeline with managed embeddings + semantic search to reduce maintenance and improve quality.
Current infra: AWS - using self-hosted Postgres + S3; experimenting with Pinecone for vector storage (pilot).
POC scope agreed: ingest 3M existing docs, run nightly batch embed job, evaluate query latency and recall on 10k queries, test Pinecone + s3-backed alternatives.
Latency targets: 95th pctile < 80ms for single-query semantic search (hosted), throughput: support 200 qps peak and nightly batch of 3M docs (within 6-8 hours).
Cost sensitivity: wants model/quantization recommendations to hit $/embed targets; target ARR impact to justify Dedicated commit.
Security: needs SSO (SAML) for console, audit logs for embeddings pipeline, and EU data residency for a subset of tenant data.
Quotes from calls: 'Need predictable nightly job completion or we miss our SLA to enterprise customers' - Head of Product.
AE notes: good PO engagement, finance team wants pricing scenarios for Hosted vs Dedicated (1yr commit).
SE notes: initial demo (2026-02-04) showed host API latency ~70ms (sample); POC next steps include stress test for throughput and vector DB integration checklist.
Decision criteria: latency & throughput (SLOs), cost per embed, ease of vector DB integration, security posture (SAML/KMS), and rollout path from Hosted -> Dedicated.
Risks: if Redwood can't show clear cost savings or dedicated sizing numbers, they will stick with Pinecone + in-house embedgers.
Next meetings: Dedicated sizing call with infra on 2026-03-02; pricing review with finance week of 2026-03-09.
POC artifacts: baseline eval dataset, 10k query set, embed pipeline scripts (drive link provided).
